value.answer: Drooling, chewing on things, and fussiness are classic teething signs as new teeth come in - cool teething rings or gentle gum rubs usually help. Teething itself doesn't cause fever, diarrhea, or rash, so watch for those separately.
value.triage: Call 811 if a real fever (38C/100.4F+) shows up, your toddler refuses fluids, or fussiness seems way beyond teething. Go to the ER or call 911 for a stiff neck, a rash that doesn't fade under pressure, unusual drowsiness, trouble breathing, or a seizure.
